LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.AutoDeploy.Desc: When enabled, the pack automatically deploys an extinguisher drone if fire is detected within a {0}-cell radius around the wearer.
LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.AutoReload.Desc: When enabled, colonists will automatically reload this pack with industrial components when it is empty.
LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.Settings.DefaultAutoRel: Determines whether newly crafted or spawned extinguisher packs have auto-reload enabled by default.
